## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
df1 <- read_csv("../data/recist_deseq2_results.csv")

```
```{r}
df2 <- df1 %>%
  drop_na(padj)


```





## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r volcano plot}


ggplot(dat=df2, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log(padj))) + geom_point()

#class(df1$log2FoldChange)
#class(df1$padj)

```

```{r}

resnon <- df2 %>%
  mutate(gene_type = case_when(log2FoldChange > 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "responder",
                               log2FoldChange < 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "non responder",
                               TRUE ~ "ns"))  




cols <- c("responder" = "#ffad73", "non responder" = "#26b3ff", "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("responder" = 2, "non responder" = 2, "ns" = 1) 
alphas <- c("responder" = 1, "non responder" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)

resnon %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj),
             fill = gene_type,    
             size = gene_type,
             alpha = gene_type)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, # Specify shape and colour as fixed local parameters    
             colour = "black") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(seq(-10, 10, 2)),       
                     limits = c(-10, 10))  

```
```{r}
resnon %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=level), shape = 21) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")
 

```



Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
